data.body:
[operator-attested] GATING-SUITE EVIDENCE for this story.

Gerrit change: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1423 (patch set 3)
Votes: LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot, PASS, 2 advisory non-blocking) AND Verified +1 (rebar CI bot, SUCCESS,
GitHub Actions run 30985950836 across the ubuntu/macos x py3.11-3.13 matrix).

Local pre-flight on the full stack: make lint clean; make typecheck clean (mypy, 434 source files);
make test = 10306 passed, 1 failed, 38 skipped, 222 deselected in 38m19s. The single failure is
tests/unit/grounding/test_coverage_reconstruction.py::test_full_backend_account_is_present, which is
PRE-EXISTING on clean origin/main (verified by stashing this entire change and re-running - identical
failure) and is NOT in CI's gating set, which is why Verified +1 was awarded. Filed as bug 0ba2-15e6-d8a6-4a2a.

Dogfooding this story's own rule - the provenance of the measurement above, in the exact syntax this
change introduces:

provenance: environment=local macOS worktree /Users/joeoakhart/e3147-provenance on branch e3147-provenance @ origin/main 2613827564, plus GitHub-hosted CI runners for run 30984363688/30985950836; principal=RebarBotNava <joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com> locally and the repository's default GITHUB_TOKEN in Actions; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — the gating suite is the SAME suite CI runs on the same commit, executed for real rather than simulated or statically analysed, and it CAN fail (it did: two genuine failures on an earlier patch set, canonical-front-matter and the pinned routing table, both fixed here), so this evidence could have come out the other way for the reason that matters.

Honest limit on the above, per ADR-0061's own trust boundary: 'production-equivalent' and 'live-call' are
SELF-DECLARED here and are not refutable from the repository. What is refutable - and what a reader should
check - is the environment claim against the recorded Gerrit change and Actions run ids.
